title: Friday Daily Practice
subtitle: Listening review of P4: a full form, traps and shadowing
source: Daily Practice tuần 16–22/11, soạn mới cho IELTS13.
intro: Làm lần lượt các bước, khoảng 16 phút. Hôm nay ôn buổi P4: Vocab Quest và một kỹ năng: Listening Section 1. Hạn nộp 23:30 cùng ngày: đủ và đúng hạn được 20 Meow, muộn hoặc làm một nửa được 10 Meow. Đừng xem đáp án trước khi làm xong.

a.label: Audio A · Green Park Cooking School (play once)

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Hi. I'm calling about the weekend cooking course for beginners.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Yes, we have a course on Italian food and one on Thai food.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I'd like the Thai one, please.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Lovely. It runs on Saturday mornings, from nine until twelve.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: It used to be four weeks, but now it is six.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: It is ninety pounds. That includes all the food.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Do I need to bring anything?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Just an apron. And please arrive ten minutes early on the first day.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: We are at 14 Mill Lane, next to the post office.

send_today: Hoàn thành các bước trên web. Voice note ở Step 4 được gửi khi bấm Nộp bài.

steps.title: Step 1 · Vocab Quest: choose the meaning (3 min)
steps.instructions: Review words (8): pick up · make progress · give up · confident · career · job satisfaction · demanding · work-life balance. Choose the correct meaning (A, B, C or D).

items.explain: make progress = tiến bộ. Example: She made great progress in her speaking.

options.A: cân bằng công việc và cuộc sống
options.C: đáng làm, mang lại giá trị

items.explain: career = sự nghiệp. Example: He wants a career in banking.
give up = từ bỏ. Example: Never give up when a task is difficult.

options.A: bắt đầu quen, biết cách làm

items.explain: demanding = đòi hỏi cao, vất vả. Example: Being a doctor is a demanding job.
pick up = học được (một cách tự nhiên). Example: I picked up some Korean from TV shows.

options.D: cân bằng công việc và cuộc sống

items.explain: work-life balance = cân bằng công việc và cuộc sống. Example: A four-day week gives workers a better work-life balance.

options.A: sự hài lòng với công việc
options.B: cân bằng công việc và cuộc sống
options.D: đáng làm, mang lại giá trị

items.explain: confident = tự tin. Example: I feel more confident when I prepare well.

options.A: sự hài lòng với công việc

items.explain: job satisfaction = sự hài lòng với công việc. Example: Good teamwork leads to high job satisfaction.

steps.title: Step 2 · Listening: cooking course form (8 min)
steps.instructions: Use the 3 steps from P4: read and predict the type of word, write numbers as digits, and wait for the final information when a speaker corrects. Play the audio ONCE. Write NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER. GREEN PARK COOKING SCHOOL · Weekend course booking.

steps.title: Step 3 · Trap check (3 min, not marked)
steps.instructions: Look at your answers in Step 2. Which questions had a trap (a correction or a wrong number first)? Write the question number and the trap.

open.q: Questions with a trap and what the trap was
open.model: Q1: Italian was mentioned first, but he chose Thai. Q4: four weeks before, now six. Q7: 40 or 14, the answer is 14.

steps.title: Step 4 · Voice note: shadowing (1 min)
steps.instructions: Read these lines aloud like the speaker. Stress the numbers clearly.
lines: It used to be four weeks, but now it is six.
We are at 14 Mill Lane, next to the post office.
steps.note: Thầy nghe trọng âm four-TEEN và âm cuối /s/.
